card.name: The word and joining two drug names
card.fires_on: The word "and" (or a gap) right after the first of two paired items, usually drug or substance names, just before the second item is named. Seen in interaction statements and in lists of dosage forms.

modes.label: And between interacting drugs
modes.description: "and" links two drugs or products that are used together, right before the second drug is named.
modes.example: Concomitant use of naproxen tablets and naproxen sodium tablets<< and>> pemetrexed may increase the risk

modes.label: And between paired substances
modes.description: "and" joins two named substances or parts, such as calcium and phosphate, before the second item.
modes.example: Calcium<< and>> phosphate ratios must be considered to prevent formation

modes.label: Gap between listed strengths
modes.description: A space between two dosage-form strengths in a table, before the next strength.
modes.example: 200 mg/50 mg Tablets and<< >>100 mg/25 mg

card.writes: It adds little clear output; the promoted tokens look like unrelated contrast words such as "Meanwhile".
card.plain: It marks the spot where a second drug or item is about to be named after "and".
